Target Material.cell: bulk chondrite; chondrule — anomalous and grouped carbonaceous chondrites; type I chondrules from Leoville (CV)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Fraction of a bulk digestion — "Another 5% fraction was used to determine Al/Mg ratios by multi-collector (MC)-ICPMS"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Handpieces cut into 2 mm slabs with a diamond wire saw; saw dust and crushed fusion-crust-free pieces digested; chondrules drilled out with tungsten carbide bits — Methods
Sample Preparation Method.value: Handpieces cut into 2 mm slabs with a diamond wire saw; saw dust and crushed fusion-crust-free pieces digested; chondrules drilled out with tungsten carbide bits

Digestion Acid(s).cell: Parr bomb: 3:1 7 M HNO3 : 28 M HF; aqua regia: aqua regia; NaOH fusion: NaOH, then Milli-Q water and HNO3

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: Parr bombs; silver crucibles for the NaOH fusion
Digestion Vessel Type.value: Parr bombs; silver crucibles for the NaOH fusion

Digestion Step.cell: Parr bomb (3:1 7 M HNO3 : 28 M HF, 1 day at 150 °C and 2 days at 210 °C); aqua regia (dried, taken up for two more days on a hotplate); NaOH fusion (Si portion, silver crucibles, 720 °C, 13 min) — Methods

Digestion Temperature.cell: Parr bomb: 150 °C, then 210 °C; aqua regia: N; NaOH fusion: 720 °C

Digestion Duration.cell: Parr bomb: 3 days; aqua regia: 2 days; NaOH fusion: 13 min

Final Solution Matrix.cell: N — the Cr cut is eluted in 6 M HCl; the measurement matrix is not stated

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: ~100–200 mg of saw dust and crushed pieces — 5% fractions for ICPMS and for Al/Mg
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: ~100–200 mg of saw dust and crushed pieces

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes, AG1-X8 anion (1 ml) for Fe, then AG50-X12 cation (1 ml) twice for Cr and Mg
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: Yes, AG1-X8 anion (1 ml) for Fe, then AG50-X12 cation (1 ml) twice for Cr and Mg

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

ESI Apex HF with an actively cooled membrane unit

RF Power.cell: N — Cr measured 'at low radiofrequency power and sample gas inflow'
